scope: Synthetic oxide graph, serial Windows Zacros 4.0

A.action: generate and read back native structural members and diagnostic templates
A.acceptance: Every generated member and the manifest must reproduce byte-for-byte. Compare graph, ordered seeds, maximum packing and both event patterns independently.

common_native_controls.binary_build_qualification: Pinned binary matches the previously executed 4.0 archive. Source inspection describes expected behavior; target execution remains unverified.
missing_input_record: total_pressure_bar and positive CO2 mole fraction (or equivalent CO2 partial pressure and total pressure)
CO2 gas molecular weight in native convention; vendor example 100 supplies 44.0096 for unlabeled CO2
adsorption pre_expon and activ_eng_eV, with units and pressure convention
desorption pre_expon and activ_eng_eV, with units
at least one complete, reviewed synthetic energetic cluster and cluster_eng_eV
common_native_controls.diagnostic_pattern_policy: Two separately named directed structural probes. Their presence does not assign physical reversibility. No equilibrium constant is needed to read these two directed step definitions.
common_native_controls.gas_reference: gas_energies omitted is a vendor warning/default, not a measured reference. Review and record the convention when binding the synthetic controls.

execution_gate.authority: Requires an independently approved stage-specific decision on the complete input and plan hashes. The binding primitive checks a module-validated decision; it does not issue one.
execution_gate.fixture_gate_scope: Archived regression replay is restricted to its benchmark inputs. No general approved oxide execution action or stage-specific launch receipt was found.

common_native_controls.run_directory: new isolated directory without an input restart.inf
common_native_controls.timeout_policy: Stop the launched process at the outer deadline, keep partial outputs and exit status, withhold acceptance. No automatic retry.
common_native_controls.rng: 23123 is a deterministic harness seed, not a material parameter.
common_native_controls.evidence_retention: Hash all input and output bytes, preserve stdout/stderr, version banner, UTC times, exit status and wall duration. Review warnings individually.

B.native_approval_request: After binding: approve only stage B on the exact input, binary and plan digests shown in the request?
acceptance: Normal termination, exit 0, Zacros 4.0 banner and zero executed events
All five Finished reading markers: simulation, lattice, energetics, mechanism and initial state
Native lattice types, reciprocal edges and node inventory exactly match the structural bundle; no fatal input error
B.process_scope: The stock binary also initializes the state and catalogues processes before it stops. Parser acceptance alone is the stage B verdict.

C.action: verify native event-zero loading and ordered event catalogue
C.native_approval_request: If a new native process is needed, approve only stage C after review of its separately bound input, binary and plan hashes?
C.read_only_reuse: If approved stage B outputs include all required raw files for the same bound model, inspect them offline and cite their originating receipt. A missing output never triggers an automatic run.

acceptance.native_entity_indices: Labels may differ from graph IDs. Require one unique ID per ordered pair, same ID on both legs, and two distinct occupied IDs.
acceptance.source_of_event_matches: Initialization block of process_debug.txt. Compare elementary step description and ordered local-to-global placement as a multiset.

C.reject_if: Any missing raw observation, reversed leg, joined distinct entity, different direction, unexpected pair, warning invalidating a measurement or event advancement.

additional_requirements: Selected scientific or synthetic rate model with defined units and gas/energy reference
Supported directionality and detailed-balance basis if reversible
Separate event/time horizon, sampling and restart protocol with independent execution approval
